perc_hh_with_broadband_geo20.long_description: Percentage of households self-reported to have a broadband internet connection. Broadband internet is defined as any type of internet other than a dial-up connection. Based on American Community Survey Table B28002 (Presence and Types of Internet Subscriptions in Household).
perc_hh_with_broadband_geo20.long_name: Percentage of households with broadband (2020 geographies)
perc_hh_with_broadband_geo20.short_description: Percentage of households with a broadband internet connection (any type other than dial-up), from ACS Table B28002.
perc_hh_with_broadband_geo20.provenance: Computed from ACS Table B28002: B28002_004 (broadband of any type) / B28002_001 (total households) × 100.
perc_hh_with_broadband_geo20.statement: {value} of households in {features.name} have a broadband connection.
